type: self-contained pipeline, NOT a wrapper over ProtoPipeline or GenerationEngine
stages: 2. lvStreamCoder() — single streaming coder LLM call (build slot)

neutral_scaffold.compile_mode: legacy — no skeletonId sent to backend
neutral_scaffold.note: LV_NEUTRAL_SKELETON_ID is used ONLY in PDS input (nominal label) and run telemetry. It is NOT passed to the compile endpoint. The compile call uses body: JSON.stringify({ files, sessionId }) so no skeleton files are installed and no index.css is force-restored.

pass2.critic: buildDeterministicGaps() always; optional LLM enrichment via qaRoute
